headline: Executive order sets up a White House Council on Supply Chain Resilience.
what_it_does: This order creates a council inside the White House focused on supply chain resilience, meaning how well the systems that make and move goods can hold up when problems happen. No summary was provided, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and White House officials
who_it_affects.how: They would take part in or work with the new council on supply chain issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Executive orders usually take effect when signed; this one was signed June 14, 2024.
